enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Wizardry V: This item grants the wearer +125 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
Exceptional Constitution +1: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +1 Exceptional bonus to Constitution.
Exceptional Intelligence +1: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +1 Exceptional bonus to Intelligence.
Arcane Casting Dexterity: This ability reduces the arcane spell failure chance by -10%.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
